summary: Ilebo territory (Kasaï) comprises Ilebo town, the Mikope and Banga Lubaka secteurs. It sits at the edge of the 2016-2017 Kamuina Nsapu theatre; militias were defeated or demobilised by 2018-2019 and no armed group is known to hold territory as of 2026. Ilebo town, a river port and railhead, is policed by the PNC with FARDC and ANR present; rural areas fall under PNC posts and customary chiefs. Assessment relies on background knowledge because live web research was unavailable in this run, so confidence is limited.

zones.description: Ilebo town (territory seat, Kasai river port and SNCC railhead) and its neighbourhoods/health areas
zones.evidence: Administrative centre and transport hub with territorial administration, PNC commissariats, ANR and FARDC/naval elements at the port. No armed group is known to have held Ilebo; Kamuina Nsapu-related unrest in Kasai in 2016-2017 did not result in lasting militia control of the town. zones.evidence: No armed-group control reported; order maintained by PNC posts, customary chiefs and the territorial administration based in nearby Ilebo. Not verified with fresh sources in this run (web search budget exhausted, other sites blocked by egress proxy).

zones.description: Mikope secteur / health zone incl. Itunda (Mapangu palm-oil plantation area), Mikope, Kabamba, Domay, Biyenge Port and villages
zones.evidence: Rural secteur along the Kasai river and around the Mapangu plantation; no armed group is known to control territory as of 2026. Security relies on PNC posts (and plantation guards around Mapangu) with occasional FARDC deployments. Not verified with fresh sources in this run (web search budget exhausted, other sites blocked by egress proxy).

zones.description: Banga Lubaka secteur / health zone (Tshimuanga/Banga centre, Wenze, Ibombo, Mabere, Pungu, Katshimu and villages) in southern Ilebo territory
zones.evidence: Southern part of the territory bordering Luebo and Kamonia, a peripheral area of the 2016-2017 Kamuina Nsapu crisis; militias were dispersed or demobilised by 2018-2019 and no armed group is known to hold territory since. Order relies on PNC posts and customary chiefs with sporadic FARDC presence. Not verified with fresh sources in this run (web search budget exhausted, other sites blocked by egress proxy).
